instruction: Please set up a desktop shortcut for this page so I can launch it quickly using Chrome's app shortcut feature.

metadata.explanation: Task variation for creating a desktop shortcut for Gmail using Chrome's app shortcut feature. Same complexity as original - opens a website and expects user to create a desktop shortcut. The app-id for Gmail is fmgjjmmmlfnkbppncabfkddbjimcfncm. Uses existing evaluator functions.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic is correct: get_shortcuts_on_desktop properly extracts .desktop files from the Desktop directory and returns their content
Metric logic is correct: is_shortcut_on_desktop with type='exec' correctly checks if the expected Exec command exists in any shortcut file
Expected value is semantically correct: the app-id fmgjjmmmlfnkbppncabfkddbjimcfncm is Gmail's actual Chrome app ID, and the exec command format matches Chrome web app shortcuts on Linux
Complete coverage: the evaluator verifies the single requirement - creating a desktop shortcut for Gmail
Desktop shortcuts persist on disk independently of Chrome state, so no postconfig is needed to reopen UI
The evaluator will work correctly at runtime - it checks for the exact Exec line that Chrome creates when making web app shortcuts
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: The evaluator assumes exact string match for the Exec line. If Chrome's shortcut creation format changes slightly (e.g., different flags, whitespace), it might not match. Consider adding flexibility for minor variations.

Minor: The evaluator doesn't verify that the shortcut actually points to Gmail URL - it only checks the app-id. This is acceptable since app-ids are unique to apps, but could be enhanced by also checking the URL if stored in the .desktop file.
